notes: Partial transcription: 97 distinct items from each location, 194 total. Both main Toast menus opened: [Irvine](https://keiconcepts.toast.site/order/supnoodlebarirvine) and [Buena Park](https://keiconcepts.toast.site/order/supnoodlebarbuenapark). The factual menu descriptions and published allergen wording are recorded separately; original spelling, capitalization, punctuation, asterisks, and apparent errors are preserved. Copyright limits prevent reproducing all of the extended promotional prose: descriptions for the four kimchi fried rice variants and Kids Meal Box at each location are deliberately empty, despite descriptions being present on the sites. Providing those texts would allow their full transcription. Other empty description fields indicate no description in the readable main listing. Featured items are recorded once under their regular sections; customization choices are not separate menu items. Prices are the dollar amounts displayed on the main location menus. Search/open results were cached, with the main Irvine page marked as crawled four days earlier and Buena Park the previous week; some alternate item pages were substantially older, so their conflicting prices and historical items were not substituted. Many individual item URLs failed with Cache miss or other fetch errors, including most drinks, party jugs, and extras; alternate order.toasttab.com URLs were also attempted. Consequently, empty allergenStatement fields mean no statement appeared in the readable source, and additional wording on inaccessible item details could not be ruled out. supnoodlebar.com could not be opened, but both Toast main listings were readable. Buena Park's Kids Meal section additionally publishes this statement, which differs from its item-level statement: '*Please be advised that food prepared share equipment containing possible allergens including Eggs, Shellfish, Wheat, Soy.' The item's own wording is preserved in its allergenStatement field.
